name: zrndr_span_copy_16_from_tex16_explicit_vshift
description: zRndr::SpanCopy16FromTex16ExplicitVShift copies 16-bit texture samples into the current span buffer with an explicit V-shift argument.
known_limits: Guarded raw MMX under RECOIL_ENABLE_ZRNDR_SPAN_MMX_RAW_ASM now preserves the BN-proven packed-index body over gRndr_Mmx_* scratch records; VC5SP3 byte verification with vc5_o2_ob0_md_zrndr_span_mmx_raw_asm_facs still fails with 295 unmasked mismatches. The expected C4799 no-EMMS warning is retained because retail has no emms in this function.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x49ec20 validates the same local destination pointer, leading scalar fixup, MMX paired body, and optional tail structure as zRndr::SpanCopy16FromTex16.
The native smoke verifies aligned odd-count output and the misaligned one-pixel leading-scalar path without mutating g_spanCurrentDst16.
